query:
INSERT INTO plans (
            id, user_id, l1_mode, l2_mode, version, is_active,
            profile_snapshot_json, l2_allocation_json, emergency_json,
            notices_json, traces_json
        )
        VALUES (
            $1, $2, $3, $4,
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) + 1 FROM plans WHERE user_id = $2),
            TRUE, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9
        )
